prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: low-speed head-on collision. Injury: back strain. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1249; do not mention it.)
text:
I write to present a claim on behalf of our client, [CLIENT_NAME], arising from the motor vehicle collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE]. Our client was traveling at a moderate speed when another vehicle crossed into her lane and struck her car nearly head-on. Although the impact was at low speed, the force of the collision threw her forward and back against the seat, and she has since been diagnosed with a lumbar strain that has required ongoing treatment, including physical therapy and prescribed medication.

Your insured's liability for this collision is clear. The police report documents the lane departure, and the other driver did not dispute the sequence of events at the scene. Our client has done everything asked of her, attending every appointment and following her treating physician's recommendations. Her back pain has limited her ability to work full shifts and to perform routine household tasks, and her recovery remains incomplete.

Based on her medical expenses to date, lost wages, and the pain and disruption she has endured, we demand payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] to resolve this claim without litigation. Supporting medical records and billing statements are enclosed. This offer remains open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we are prepared to file suit to recover the full value of her losses.
